notes.title: First Playtest!
notes.content:
I am looking for feedback about the core design, aesthetics, and/or gameplay. If you experienced any major bugs or issues feel free to mention it, but it is not the goal of this playtest to gather bugs this early in development :)


Click here to give feedback: [url=https://forms.gle/SMUm4pwGq2kGRcNQA]Feedback form[/url]

P.S. If I have not given you a key directly and you clicked "Request Access" on the Steam page, there may be some delays in giving you access.
